description: Header file defining the ScreenShot class for capturing and manipulating screenshots within a Qt application, including enums for shot states and control points, methods for screenshot operations, and UI interaction handling.

classes.name: ScreenShot
classes.description: A class for capturing, selecting, and manipulating screenshots with UI controls and signals.

methods.name: partScreenShot
methods.description: Performs a partial screenshot and saves it to the specified path.

methods.name: fullScreenShot
methods.description: Captures a screenshot of the entire screen.

methods.name: windowScreenShot
methods.description: Captures a screenshot of the current window.

methods.name: loadBackgroundPixmap
methods.description: Loads a background pixmap for screenshot overlay.
